title: ILLIT: Magnetic Debut Quiz
description: Ten easy questions on ILLIT's debut: R U Next?, Belift Lab, the five members, Magnetic and their first EPs.

questions.question: Which TV channel aired R U Next?, the 2023 survival show that formed ILLIT?
questions.fun_fact: The show ran for ten episodes from June to September 2023, with 22 contestants competing for a place in the group.

questions.question: Which HYBE label manages ILLIT?
questions.fun_fact: Belift Lab also manages the boy group ENHYPEN, which it formed through the 2020 survival show I-Land.

questions.question: Which HYBE chairman took part as a producer on ILLIT's debut EP?
questions.fun_fact: The EP came out on March 25, 2024, the date of the group's official debut.

questions.question: What is the title of ILLIT's debut EP?
questions.fun_fact: Super Real Me sold more than 380,000 physical copies worldwide in its first week and passed 500,000 by the end of April 2024.

questions.question: Which Super Real Me track got its own music video on April 17, 2024?
questions.fun_fact: The debut EP has four tracks, in this order: My World, Magnetic, Midnight Fiction and Lucky Girl Syndrome.

questions.question: Magnetic was the first K-pop group debut song on the Billboard Hot 100. Where did it enter?
questions.fun_fact: Billboard named ILLIT its first-ever K-Pop Rookie of the Month, for June 2024.

questions.question: Where did ILLIT make their first public appearance as a group, before their debut?
questions.fun_fact: They attended the Acne Studios show there, then became the faces of the brand's SS24 global campaign in March 2024.

questions.question: Which of these singers is a member of ILLIT?
questions.fun_fact: Belift Lab's official profile lists five members: Yunah, Minju, Moka, Wonhee and Iroha.

questions.question: According to Belift Lab, ILLIT's name joins the phrase I will with which pronoun?
questions.fun_fact: Belift Lab says I will stands for an independent, adventurous spirit, while It symbolizes something unique.

questions.question: Which song led the second ILLIT EP, I'll Like You, in October 2024?
questions.fun_fact: An English version of Tick-Tack from the same EP, titled Baby It's Both, featured American singer Ava Max.

title: K-pop at Big Sporting Events
description: From the World Cup and the Olympics to esports finals: ten easy questions on Korean music stars who took part in big sporting events.

questions.question: Which BTS member performed Dreamers at the 2022 FIFA World Cup opening ceremony in Qatar?
questions.fun_fact: Dreamers features Qatari singer Fahad Al Kubaisi and was part of the tournament's official soundtrack.

questions.question: Which 2NE1 leader performed The Baddest Female at the PyeongChang 2018 Winter Olympics closing ceremony?
questions.fun_fact: EXO also performed Growl and Power in the same concert section, and DJ Martin Garrix headlined the afterparty.

questions.question: Which girl group sang Gods, the theme song of the 2023 League of Legends World Championship?
questions.fun_fact: The South Korean team T1 went on to win that year's tournament.

questions.question: Which boy group carried the PyeongChang 2018 Olympic flame together in Seoul on January 13, 2018?
questions.fun_fact: Their third Japanese single followed on January 31 and featured Spotlight, the first original song they recorded in Japanese.

questions.question: Which band sang Hand in Hand, the theme song of the 1988 Seoul Olympics?
questions.fun_fact: The song was composed and produced by Giorgio Moroder, with English lyrics by Tom Whitlock.

questions.question: Which two K-pop boy groups performed at the closing ceremony of the 2018 Asian Games in Jakarta?
questions.fun_fact: Indian singer Sidharth Slathia also performed at the ceremony, alongside Indonesian artists.

questions.question: Which group sang Only One, the official theme song of the 2014 Incheon Asian Games?
questions.fun_fact: They performed it in a medley with Flame and Empty during the torch relay section of the opening ceremony.

questions.question: Which singer closed the 2014 Asian Games opening ceremony alongside pianist Lang Lang?
questions.fun_fact: He performed a remake of his early single Champion and his global hit Gangnam Style.

questions.question: Which BTS member served as a torchbearer for the Paris 2024 Summer Olympics?
questions.fun_fact: He carried the flame for the South Korean delegation, then launched his solo variety show Run Jin in August 2024.

questions.question: Which EXO member represented Heartsteel, the virtual boy band unveiled at the 2023 League of Legends Worlds?
questions.fun_fact: The virtual group's other human counterparts were ØZI, Tobi Lou and Cal Scruby.

title: BTS: The Dynamite to Proof Era
description: Ten questions on BTS from 2020 to 2022: Dynamite, BE and Life Goes On, Butter, Permission to Dance, My Universe and Proof.

questions.question: In 2020, Dynamite made BTS the first all-South Korean act to top which chart?
questions.fun_fact: Dynamite was the band's first song fully recorded in English, and it sold 265,000 downloads in its first US week.

questions.question: Dynamite earned BTS their first Grammy nomination. In which category?
questions.fun_fact: The nomination, at the 63rd Annual Grammy Awards, made BTS the first Korean pop act nominated for a Grammy.

questions.question: Which song was the lead single of BE, released in November 2020?
questions.fun_fact: Life Goes On became the first primarily Korean-language song to debut at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

questions.question: Which member directed the music video for Life Goes On, the BE lead single?
questions.fun_fact: On BE, Jimin handled A&R as the link between the group and their label, while V and RM supervised graphics and design.

questions.question: How many non-consecutive weeks did Butter spend at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100?
questions.fun_fact: Its video drew 108.2 million YouTube views in 24 hours and set four Guinness World Records.

questions.question: Which British singer is among the writers of Permission to Dance (2021)?
questions.fun_fact: Its video uses sign language in the choreography, and BTS performed it at the 76th United Nations General Assembly.

questions.question: Which band teamed up with BTS on My Universe, a Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 in 2021?
questions.fun_fact: No song billed to two lead groups had reached No. 1 on the Hot 100 before it, and it gave BTS their sixth US chart-topper.

questions.question: Which song was the lead single of Proof, BTS's 2022 anthology album?
questions.fun_fact: It was BTS's first original Korean-language single since Life Goes On, co-written by RM, Suga and J-Hope.

questions.question: In which US city did the Permission to Dance on Stage concerts end in April 2022?
questions.fun_fact: BTS played four nights to about 200,000 fans at Allegiant Stadium, setting the all-time Billboard box office record for Las Vegas.

questions.question: In October 2022, BTS gave a concert in which city to support its bid to host the 2030 World Expo?
questions.fun_fact: The October 15 concert was held under the banner Yet to Come.

title: K-pop Weather and Season Songs
description: Spring Day, Hot Summer, The First Snow: ten easy questions on K-pop songs and albums named after weather and seasons.

questions.question: Which group released Spring Day in February 2017?
questions.fun_fact: RM and Suga are among its writers, and it led You Never Walk Alone, the 2017 repackage of Wings.

questions.question: EXO's 2013 winter EP Miracles in December has a track named after a snowfall. Which one?
questions.fun_fact: It became a Korean favorite for the first snowfall of the year, and in 2023, a decade on, it climbed to No. 1 on the Circle Digital Chart.

questions.question: Which BIGBANG song has a Korean title that means Spring Summer Fall Winter?
questions.fun_fact: Released on April 5, 2022, it was their first release in four years, following Flower Road in 2018.

questions.question: Which Stray Kids lead single from August 2021 takes its English title from thunder?
questions.fun_fact: Its Korean title, Sori-kkun, refers to a pansori singer, and the track mixes trap with Korean traditional music.

questions.question: Which girl group released a Korean version of Hot Summer in June 2011?
questions.fun_fact: The song was first recorded by German pop group Monrose in 2007.

questions.question: Which Red Velvet summer EP from August 2018 was led by Power Up?
questions.fun_fact: It also included an English version of Bad Boy, the group's first song released in English.

questions.question: What was the title of the TWICE summer reissue from July 2018, led by Dance the Night Away?
questions.fun_fact: It expanded their EP What Is Love?, and the lead single's music video was filmed in Japan.

questions.question: Which girl group released Sunny Summer in July 2018?
questions.fun_fact: Source Music released it as the title track of the group's seventh EP, also named Sunny Summer.

questions.question: Which Girls' Generation member released the solo song Rain in February 2016?
questions.fun_fact: Rain and its B-side Secret opened SM Station, the weekly digital music project of SM Entertainment.

questions.question: Which boy group released Spring Breeze as the lead single of its only studio album in 2018?
questions.fun_fact: The album was the group's final release before it disbanded in January 2019.

title: K-pop First Studio Albums True or False
description: Ten true or false statements about the first full-length albums of K-pop groups, from Super Junior and BIGBANG to i-dle.

questions.question: The first studio album by Girls' Generation was The Boys.
questions.fun_fact: Their first studio album was the self-titled Girls' Generation, released by SM Entertainment on November 1, 2007.

questions.question: BIGBANG's first studio album, BigBang Vol.1, came out in 2006.
questions.fun_fact: It was released on December 22, 2006, through YG Entertainment and went on to sell more than 110,000 copies.

questions.question: SHINee's first studio album was The Shinee World.
questions.fun_fact: Released in August 2008, it was led by Love Like Oxygen, a remake of a song by Danish singer Martin Hoberg Hedegaard.

questions.question: 2NE1's first studio album was Crush.
questions.fun_fact: Their first studio album was To Anyone in 2010; Crush, released in 2014, was their second and final one.

questions.question: EXO's first studio album was XOXO.
questions.fun_fact: XOXO came out in June 2013 and won Album of the Year at the 2013 Mnet Asian Music Awards.

questions.question: BTS's first Korean studio album was Wings.
questions.fun_fact: Their debut studio album was Dark & Wild, released in August 2014 with Danger as its lead single.

questions.question: MAMAMOO's first studio album was Melting.
questions.fun_fact: Melting arrived on February 26, 2016, and its single You're the Best gave the group its first music show win.

questions.question: Super Junior's first studio album was Sorry, Sorry.
questions.fun_fact: Their first album was Twins, released on November 28, 2005; Sorry, Sorry, from March 2009, was their third.

questions.question: Stray Kids' first studio album was 5-Star.
questions.fun_fact: Their first full-length album was Go Live, released on June 17, 2020, with the lead single God's Menu.

questions.question: i-dle's first studio album, released when the group was still called (G)I-DLE, was I Never Die.
questions.fun_fact: Released in 2022, it was led by Tomboy, which reached No. 1 on the Circle Digital Chart.
